method: Bounded CIL-record interpretation, not target execution. KIf5 measurement, RTF editor height, indicator rectangle, effective provider and notification sinks are explicit.

scope.owner: ordinary SelectionButton; no general transform, owner/text rotation, active text editor except named sink case
scope.indicator: Source XNUc retained; N5pp source-space2 toWorld0 size conversion injected (default synthetic identity2x2); page/diagram origins equal
scope.geometry: Source YJ0S/uJ0j/xJ0B validation/order; minimum size and final effective provider writes injected
scope.notifications: Order recorded; external subscribers, ancestor refit and inline-link synchronization not executed
scope.measurement: Source INOR/GtCX/dtCa/rounding retained; KIf5 returned size is synthetic, not a font or GUI measurement
scope.exceptionFinally: CIL EH metadata checked; exact guard callback registered with interpreter cleanup, no general CLR EH emulation
